children.html:
Where Adventure Meets Tranquility

Mocean Beach Resort

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-c0c2708 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Mocean Beach Resort offers unforgettable diving in pristine, unexplored waters and is the perfect launch point for divers exploring Indonesia. With expert guides and just four certified divers per group, each dive trip becomes a chance to uncover hidden underwater gems. Encounter manta rays, reef sharks, and eagle rays on the dive sites while enjoying the comfort of a boutique dive trip (Indonesia) experience. Whether you’re planning short dive trips or extended Indonesia dive trips, our diver-designed center is equipped with private lockers, a spacious wet area, and an air-conditioned camera room to support comfort and gear care.

Your Dive, Your Way

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-54c4918f elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: A typical dive trip includes two boat dives, departing from the resort in the morning between 7 a.m. and 9 a.m., depending on the tides. We offer special packages for Indonesia dive trips, ranging from a three-day plan with six boat dives to a ten-day plan with twenty boat dives for those seeking longer dive trips. Our certified instructors provide courses from open water through rescue diver, ensuring every dive trip is safe, structured, and enriching.

Relax, Recharge, and Discover Sumbawa

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-605d1e5d elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Your dive adventure doesn’t end when you surface. Mocean Beach Resort offers quiet beaches, breathtaking sunsets, and easy access to Sumbawa’s hidden gems. Spend an afternoon exploring nearby villages, trek to cascading waterfalls, or simply unwind with massage after a day of diving. Whether you crave exploration or pure relaxation, our boutique setting lets you enjoy Indonesia’s natural beauty at your own pace. Every stay is designed to refresh your body and inspire your next dive.

Experience More Than Diving

children.classes: elementor-element elementor-element-b240dfc elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor
children.html: Beyond the crystal-clear waters, Sumbawa invites you to explore its wild side. Hike scenic coastal trails, visit traditional fishing villages, or take a day trip to secluded beaches where you can swim, snorkel, and soak in untouched beauty. For those seeking culture, local markets and ceremonies reveal the island’s rich heritage. Whether you’re chasing adrenaline or peaceful escapes, every moment here adds a new layer to your Indonesian journey.

children.html:
Do I need certification to dive here?

No. Beginners can join guided intro dives or take PADI courses, while certified divers enjoy full access to all sites.

When’s the best time to visit?

April–October offers the clearest water and calm seas, but we dive year-round with site options for any season.

Are PADI courses available?

Yes. Tanks, weights, and full rental gear are provided, plus private lockers and a camera room for safe storage.

How many dives can I book?

Packages range from 6 dives over 3 days to 20 dives over 10 days, with custom plans available.

Are the dive sites beginner-friendly?

Absolutely. Calm reefs suit newcomers, while wrecks, walls, and manta spots challenge experienced divers.
